name: application-milestone-card
title: Milestone Marker Card
description: Dated goal cards with a progress bar, linked-task count, and contributor avatars, plus a compact list-row variant for milestone overviews.
useWhen: Dated goal cards with a progress bar, linked-task count, and contributor avatars, plus a compact list-row variant for milestone overviews.
avoidWhen: Avoid milestone marker card when a simpler pattern communicates the same content or action.
responsiveBehavior: Milestone Marker Card uses responsive Tailwind utilities where present. Test its layout and interaction states at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths before shipping.
accessibility: Provide meaningful alternative text for informative images and empty alt text for decorative images.
